OUR VISION

Empowering Every Child to Reach Their Fullest Potential

We, at Indian Public School, recognize that each child is an individual and respect the individual needs of children. With a stress on the total development of each child – moral, intellectual, social, emotional, physical and spiritual – we aim to provide students with the skills and exploratory experiences that shall enable them to reach their fullest potential as independent thinkers in order to adapt and adjust to a diverse and ever-changing world and lead a healthy, productive and meaningful life.


01

Holistic Development

Student development is catalyzed across intellectual, social, emotional, physical, spiritual and aesthetic qualities.

02

Lifelong Learning

We use the latest educational techniques to create the best learning experience and encourage a lifelong pursuit of knowledge.

03

Growth & Guidance

Student growth is promoted through empowerment, school teams, career guidance and counselling.

04

Nine Essential Life Skills

We nurture decision making, problem solving, critical thinking, effective communication, interpersonal relationships, self-awareness, empathy, self-esteem and stress handling.

05

Sports & Creative Excellence

Holistic development is encouraged through excellence in sports and enrichment through creative and performing arts.

06

Responsible Global Citizens

We instil the right attitude and approach for a happy, balanced life while preparing children to become responsible global citizens with strong professional skills and appreciation for the environment.

OUR IDENTITY

An Indian Mind. An Indian Heart. An Indian Soul.

We celebrate a culture of excellence and values, nurturing students with a strong connection to Indian heritage while preparing them for the opportunities and responsibilities of the modern world.

OUR MISSION

Challenge, Support & Inspire

We strive to provide within a student-centred, safe, supportive, challenging environment, a well-balanced instructional program that will empower children to reach their educational and personal potential while nurturing their self-confidence and self-esteem.

We seek to help each child discover and hone their innate talents and instil high standards for academic scholarship, integrity, leadership, cooperation, respect for individual differences and community values, compassion for others, civic mindedness, courage to act on their beliefs and responsible citizenship.

“Our mission, simply put, is to challenge and support students to be the best they can be.”
01

Academic Excellence

To provide students with a learning environment and strengthen a culture of academic excellence.

02

All-Round Development

To support students' all-round development through character building, teamwork, physical development and a strong sense of leadership.

03

Indian Values

To illuminate students' intellect in multi-dimensional ways, preparing them for advanced academic study without compromising rich Indian values.

CBSE Affiliated Structured & Holistic Education
Our Academic Framework

Learning with Purpose

Indian Public School is affiliated to The Central Board of Secondary Education (CBSE).

The Central Board of Secondary Education, established in 1929, enjoys the distinction of being one of the oldest and largest Boards of Secondary Education in India. It has about 15,000 affiliated schools in India and across 24 other countries of the world.

CBSE affiliated schools follow a uniform curriculum with a flexible scheme of studies suitable to the needs of each and every student. Notwithstanding geographical variations, the schools and students under CBSE enjoy and share common privileges regarding the curriculum, examinations, and academic innovations.

Education Beyond the Classroom

The CBSE envisions a robust, vibrant and holistic school education that will engender excellence in every sphere of human endeavour. The Board is committed to providing quality education to promote intellectual, social and cultural vivacity among its learners.

It works towards evolving a learning process and environment which empowers future citizens to become global leaders in the emerging knowledge society. The board advocates continuous and comprehensive evaluation with an emphasis on holistic development of learners, committing itself to provide a stress-free learning environment that develops competent, confident and enterprising citizens who will promote harmony and peace.

Learning Based Activity

The old-school model of passively learning facts and reciting them out of context is no longer sufficient to prepare students to survive in today's world. Solving highly complex problems requires that students have both fundamental skills (reading, writing, and math) and 21st century skills (teamwork, problem-solving, research gathering, time management, information synthesizing, utilizing high tech tools). With this combination of skills, students become directors and managers of their learning process, guided and mentored by a skilled teacher. We at IPS ensures that students are kept at the centre of the entire learning process and all the teaching activities like examinations, workshops, projects, assignments must revolve around him to ensure vertical and 360-degree development of the child.

Career Guidance cell


The Career information and guidance department at IPS is committed towards providing an effective platform to students to enable them to make informed decisions about their future. It provides leadership in the development and implementation of a comprehensive career education program that promotes knowledge of careers and all types of employment opportunities and that emphasizes to students the advantages of completing school with marketable skills. The School's career guidance program is based on the principles of self-development, career exploration and career management. The department provides professional guidance which is informative and most importantly tailored to each and every student's talents and aptitudes.

This preparation starts from class IX culminating beyond class Xll when the students seek, apply and attain admissions in various universities in India. The sessions help create awareness regarding various career paths beyond the conventional ones after identifying suitable courses with the help of aptitude tests and interactions. Emphasis is laid on providing each and every student the advice and guidance which is appropriate and relevant to his or her individual interests and abilities. The department works towards fostering a positive partnership between the school and each student, of course supported by the parents. The child is encouraged to use the school's resources and maximize the opportunities available in the realm of higher studies (both in India and abroad).

The Career Information and Guidance Department provides assistance in the following areas:

Information about various career options in Robotics, Avionics, Banking, IT, AI and many emerging fields.

Psychometric Analysis of student  to gauge their inherent potentials . 

Supports and administers University applications-making transcripts, recommendation letters predicted grades and the School profile.

Corresponds and follows-up with universities regarding student’s applications.

Arrange talks by university representatives and other eminent experts. Internship in the corporate sector to sensitize to the atmosphere, demands, skills and expectations of a work place.

<div class="wysiwyg-page-wrapper" data-canvas-mode="desktop" style="background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255);  padding: 32px 24px; margin: 0 auto; width: 100%; max-width: 100%; border-radius: 0px; min-height: 100%; box-sizing: border-box; overflow-x: hidden; word-wrap: break-word; overflow-wrap: break-word;"><div class="ips-methodology-page">

  <style>
    .ips-methodology-page {
      --ips-blue: #123B70;
      --ips-dark-blue: #082A52;
      --ips-yellow: #F4C430;
      --ips-bg: #f4f8fd;
      --ips-text: #172033;
      --ips-muted: #64748b;
      --ips-border: #dce6f2;

      width: 100%;
      color: var(--ips-text);
      font-family: var(--font-sans), sans-serif;
      line-height: 1.6;
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    .ips-methodology-page *,
    .ips-methodology-page *::before,
    .ips-methodology-page *::after {
      box-sizing: border-box;
    }

    .ips-methodology-page h1,
    .ips-methodology-page h2,
    .ips-methodology-page h3,
    .ips-methodology-page p {
      margin: 0;
    }

    .ips-methodology-page img {
      display: block;
      max-width: 100%;
    }

    /* =========================
       COMMON
    ========================== */

    .ips-methodology-container {
      width: min(1200px, calc(100% - 48px));
      margin: 0 auto;
    }

    .ips-methodology-label {
      display: inline-block;
      color: var(--ips-blue);
      font-size: 0.78rem;
      font-weight: 800;
      letter-spacing: 0.18em;
      line-height: 1.4;
      text-transform: uppercase;
    }

    .ips-methodology-title {
      margin-top: 10px !important;
      color: var(--ips-dark-blue);
      font-size: clamp(2rem, 4vw, 2.8rem);
      font-weight: 800;
      line-height: 1.15;
    }

    .ips-methodology-line {
      width: 72px;
      height: 5px;
      margin-top: 20px;
      border-radius: 50px;
      background: var(--ips-yellow);
    }

    .ips-methodology-description {
      margin-top: 22px !important;
      color: var(--ips-muted);
      font-size: 1rem;
      line-height: 1.85;
    }

    /* =========================
       HERO
    ========================== */

    .ips-methodology-hero {
      position: relative;
      overflow: hidden;
      background: var(--ips-dark-blue);
      padding: 82px 0;
    }

    .ips-methodology-hero::before {
      content: "";
      position: absolute;
      width: 290px;
      height: 290px;
      left: -110px;
      top: -120px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: rgb(244 196 48 / 0.10);
    }

    .ips-methodology-hero::after {
      content: "";
      position: absolute;
      width: 330px;
      height: 330px;
      right: -140px;
      bottom: -170px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: rgb(255 255 255 / 0.05);
    }

    .ips-methodology-hero-inner {
      position: relative;
      z-index: 1;
    }

    .ips-methodology-hero-badge {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 9px;
      padding: 9px 16px;
      border: 1px solid rgb(244 196 48 / 0.4);
      border-radius: 50px;
      background: rgb(244 196 48 / 0.10);
      color: var(--ips-yellow);
      font-size: 0.82rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      letter-spacing: 0.04em;
    }

    .ips-methodology-hero-title {
      margin-top: 22px !important;
      max-width: 850px;
      color: #fff;
      font-size: clamp(2.5rem, 6vw, 4.4rem);
      font-weight: 900;
      line-height: 1.05;
      letter-spacing: -0.03em;
    }

    .ips-methodology-hero-title span {
      color: var(--ips-yellow);
    }

    .ips-methodology-hero-text {
      max-width: 760px;
      margin-top: 24px !important;
      color: #dbeafe;
      font-size: 1.12rem;
      line-height: 1.8;
    }

    /* =========================
       INTRO
    ========================== */

    .ips-methodology-intro {
      background: #fff;
      padding: 82px 0;
    }

    .ips-methodology-intro-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) minmax(0, 1fr);
      align-items: center;
      gap: 70px;
    }

    .ips-methodology-image-wrap {
      position: relative;
    }

    .ips-methodology-image-wrap::before {
      content: "";
      position: absolute;
      width: 115px;
      height: 115px;
      left: -20px;
      bottom: -22px;
      border-radius: 28px;
      background: rgb(244 196 48 / 0.28);
    }

    .ips-methodology-image-wrap::after {
      content: "";
      position: absolute;
      width: 90px;
      height: 90px;
      right: -18px;
      top: -18px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: rgb(18 59 112 / 0.10);
    }

    .ips-methodology-image-card {
      position: relative;
      z-index: 1;
      overflow: hidden;
      border: 8px solid #fff;
      border-radius: 28px;
      background: #fff;
      box-shadow: 0 20px 45px rgb(15 23 42 / 0.14);
    }

    .ips-methodology-image-card img {
      width: 100%;
      height: 430px;
      object-fit: cover;
    }

    .ips-methodology-highlight {
      display: flex;
      align-items: flex-start;
      gap: 14px;
      margin-top: 28px;
      padding: 18px 20px;
      border-left: 4px solid var(--ips-yellow);
      border-radius: 0 16px 16px 0;
      background: rgb(18 59 112 / 0.05);
    }

    .ips-methodology-highlight-icon {
      flex-shrink: 0;
      color: var(--ips-blue);
      font-size: 1.2rem;
    }

    .ips-methodology-highlight p {
      color: var(--ips-dark-blue);
      font-size: 0.94rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      line-height: 1.7;
    }

    /* =========================
       4Cs
    ========================== */

    .ips-methodology-skills {
      background: var(--ips-bg);
      padding: 82px 0;
    }

    .ips-methodology-heading-center {
      max-width: 760px;
      margin: 0 auto;
      text-align: center;
    }

    .ips-methodology-heading-center .ips-methodology-line {
      margin-left: auto;
      margin-right: auto;
    }

    .ips-methodology-heading-center .ips-methodology-description {
      max-width: 700px;
      margin-left: auto !important;
      margin-right: auto !important;
    }

    .ips-methodology-skills-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);
      gap: 22px;
      margin-top: 48px;
    }

    .ips-methodology-skill-card {
      padding: 28px;
      border: 1px solid var(--ips-border);
      border-radius: 25px;
      background: #fff;
      box-shadow: 0 3px 12px rgb(15 23 42 / 0.04);
      transition: transform 0.3s ease, box-shadow 0.3s ease;
    }

    .ips-methodology-skill-card:hover {
      transform: translateY(-7px);
      box-shadow: 0 18px 35px rgb(15 23 42 / 0.10);
    }

    .ips-methodology-skill-icon {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      width: 55px;
      height: 55px;
      border-radius: 16px;
      background: var(--ips-yellow);
      color: var(--ips-dark-blue);
      font-size: 1.35rem;
    }

    .ips-methodology-skill-card h3 {
      margin-top: 20px !important;
      color: var(--ips-dark-blue);
      font-size: 1.1rem;
      font-weight: 800;
      line-height: 1.35;
    }

    .ips-methodology-skill-card p {
      margin-top: 9px !important;
      color: var(--ips-muted);
      font-size: 0.88rem;
      line-height: 1.7;
    }

    /* =========================
       METHODOLOGY HIGHLIGHTS
    ========================== */

    .ips-methodology-highlights {
      background: #fff;
      padding: 82px 0;
    }

    .ips-methodology-section-badge {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
      padding: 9px 16px;
      border-radius: 50px;
      background: rgb(244 196 48 / 0.20);
      color: var(--ips-dark-blue);
      font-size: 0.82rem;
      font-weight: 800;
    }

    .ips-methodology-methods-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
      gap: 20px;
      margin-top: 48px;
    }

    .ips-methodology-method-card {
      display: flex;
      align-items: flex-start;
      gap: 18px;
      padding: 27px;
      border: 1px solid var(--ips-border);
      border-radius: 24px;
      background: #fff;
      box-shadow: 0 3px 12px rgb(15 23 42 / 0.04);
      transition: transform 0.3s ease, box-shadow 0.3s ease;
    }

    .ips-methodology-method-card:hover {
      transform: translateY(-5px);
      box-shadow: 0 16px 32px rgb(15 23 42 / 0.09);
    }

    .ips-methodology-method-number {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      flex: 0 0 48px;
      width: 48px;
      height: 48px;
      border-radius: 14px;
      background: var(--ips-yellow);
      color: var(--ips-dark-blue);
      font-size: 0.76rem;
      font-weight: 900;
    }

    .ips-methodology-method-card h3 {
      color: var(--ips-dark-blue);
      font-size: 1.1rem;
      font-weight: 800;
      line-height: 1.4;
    }

    .ips-methodology-method-card p {
      margin-top: 8px !important;
      color: var(--ips-muted);
      font-size: 0.89rem;
      line-height: 1.72;
    }

    .ips-methodology-tags {
      display: flex;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      gap: 7px;
      margin-top: 17px;
    }

    .ips-methodology-tag {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      padding: 6px 10px;
      border: 1px solid #dbeafe;
      border-radius: 50px;
      background: #eff6ff;
      color: var(--ips-blue);
      font-size: 0.69rem;
      font-weight: 700;
    }

    /* =========================
       LEARNING MODEL
    ========================== */

    .ips-methodology-learning {
      background: var(--ips-dark-blue);
      padding: 82px 0;
    }

    .ips-methodology-learning-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 0.95fr) minmax(0, 1.05fr);
      align-items: center;
      gap: 70px;
    }

    .ips-methodology-learning .ips-methodology-label {
      color: var(--ips-yellow);
    }

    .ips-methodology-learning .ips-methodology-title {
      color: #fff;
    }

    .ips-methodology-learning .ips-methodology-description {
      color: #dbeafe;
    }

    .ips-methodology-steps {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
      gap: 16px;
    }

    .ips-methodology-step {
      padding: 24px;
      border: 1px solid rgb(255 255 255 / 0.12);
      border-radius: 22px;
      background: rgb(255 255 255 / 0.055);
      transition: transform 0.3s ease, border-color 0.3s ease;
    }

    .ips-methodology-step:hover {
      transform: translateY(-5px);
      border-color: rgb(244 196 48 / 0.5);
    }

    .ips-methodology-step-number {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      width: 42px;
      height: 42px;
      border-radius: 12px;
      background: var(--ips-yellow);
      color: var(--ips-dark-blue);
      font-size: 0.75rem;
      font-weight: 900;
    }

    .ips-methodology-step h3 {
      margin-top: 15px !important;
      color: #fff;
      font-size: 1.05rem;
      font-weight: 800;
    }

    .ips-methodology-step p {
      margin-top: 6px !important;
      color: #bfdbfe;
      font-size: 0.84rem;
      line-height: 1.65;
    }

    /* =========================
       PROGRESS EVALUATION
    ========================== */

    .ips-methodology-evaluation {
      background: var(--ips-bg);
      padding: 82px 0;
    }

    .ips-methodology-evaluation-box {
      overflow: hidden;
      border: 1px solid var(--ips-border);
      border-radius: 32px;
      background: #fff;
      box-shadow: 0 18px 40px rgb(15 23 42 / 0.09);
    }

    .ips-methodology-evaluation-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 0.4fr 0.6fr;
    }

    .ips-methodology-evaluation-left {
      padding: 48px;
      background: var(--ips-blue);
    }

    .ips-methodology-evaluation-icon {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      width: 62px;
      height: 62px;
      border-radius: 17px;
      background: var(--ips-yellow);
      color: var(--ips-dark-blue);
      font-size: 1.45rem;
    }

    .ips-methodology-evaluation-left h2 {
      margin-top: 25px !important;
      color: #fff;
      font-size: 2rem;
      font-weight: 800;
      line-height: 1.2;
    }

    .ips-methodology-evaluation-left p {
      margin-top: 18px !important;
      color: #dbeafe;
      line-height: 1.8;
    }

    .ips-methodology-evaluation-right {
      padding: 48px;
    }

    .ips-methodology-evaluation-right h3 {
      margin-top: 10px !important;
      color: var(--ips-dark-blue);
      font-size: 1.55rem;
      font-weight: 800;
      line-height: 1.3;
    }

    .ips-methodology-evaluation-right > p {
      margin-top: 17px !important;
      color: var(--ips-muted);
      line-height: 1.8;
    }

    .ips-methodology-levels {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
      gap: 14px;
      margin-top: 26px;
    }

    .ips-methodology-level {
      padding: 20px;
      border-radius: 18px;
      background: #f8fafc;
    }

    .ips-methodology-level strong {
      display: block;
      color: var(--ips-blue);
      font-size: 1.25rem;
      font-weight: 900;
    }

    .ips-methodology-level span {
      display: block;
      margin-top: 5px;
      color: var(--ips-muted);
      font-size: 0.82rem;
    }

    /* =========================
       CORE VALUES
    ========================== */

    .ips-methodology-values {
      background: #fff;
      padding: 82px 0;
    }

    .ips-methodology-values-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);
      gap: 20px;
      margin-top: 48px;
    }

    .ips-methodology-value-card {
      padding: 26px 22px;
      border: 1px solid var(--ips-border);
      border-radius: 23px;
      background: #fff;
      text-align: center;
      transition: transform 0.3s ease, box-shadow 0.3s ease;
    }

    .ips-methodology-value-card:hover {
      transform: translateY(-6px);
      box-shadow: 0 15px 30px rgb(15 23 42 / 0.08);
    }

    .ips-methodology-value-icon {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      width: 50px;
      height: 50px;
      margin: 0 auto;
      border-radius: 15px;
      background: var(--ips-yellow);
      color: var(--ips-dark-blue);
      font-size: 1.15rem;
      font-weight: 900;
    }

    .ips-methodology-value-card h3 {
      margin-top: 17px !important;
      color: var(--ips-dark-blue);
      font-size: 1.02rem;
      font-weight: 800;
    }

    .ips-methodology-value-card p {
      margin-top: 7px !important;
      color: var(--ips-muted);
      font-size: 0.83rem;
      line-height: 1.65;
    }

    /* =========================
       FINAL
    ========================== */

    .ips-methodology-final {
      padding: 82px 0;
      background: var(--ips-bg);
      text-align: center;
    }

    .ips-methodology-final-inner {
      max-width: 820px;
      margin: 0 auto;
    }

    .ips-methodology-final-icon {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      width: 64px;
      height: 64px;
      margin: 0 auto;
      border-radius: 18px;
      background: var(--ips-yellow);
      color: var(--ips-dark-blue);
      font-size: 1.5rem;
      box-shadow: 0 10px 20px rgb(15 23 42 / 0.12);
    }

    .ips-methodology-final h2 {
      margin-top: 25px !important;
      color: var(--ips-dark-blue);
      font-size: clamp(2rem, 4vw, 2.8rem);
      font-weight: 900;
      line-height: 1.2;
    }

    .ips-methodology-final p {
      margin-top: 18px !important;
      color: var(--ips-muted);
      line-height: 1.85;
    }

    .ips-methodology-final-tags {
      display: flex;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      justify-content: center;
      gap: 10px;
      margin-top: 30px;
    }

    .ips-methodology-final-tag {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      padding: 10px 19px;
      border-radius: 50px;
      font-size: 0.8rem;
      font-weight: 800;
    }

    .ips-methodology-final-tag-blue {
      background: var(--ips-blue);
      color: #fff;
    }

    .ips-methodology-final-tag-yellow {
      background: var(--ips-yellow);
      color: var(--ips-dark-blue);
    }

    /* =========================
       LARGE TABLET
    ========================== */

    @media (max-width: 1050px) {
      .ips-methodology-container {
        width: min(100% - 40px, 920px);
      }

      .ips-methodology-intro-grid,
      .ips-methodology-learning-grid {
        gap: 45px;
      }

      .ips-methodology-skills-grid,
      .ips-methodology-values-grid {
        grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
      }
    }

    /* =========================
       TABLET
    ========================== */

    @media (max-width: 850px) {
      .ips-methodology-hero {
        padding: 68px 0;
      }

      .ips-methodology-intro,
      .ips-methodology-skills,
      .ips-methodology-highlights,
      .ips-methodology-learning,
      .ips-methodology-evaluation,
      .ips-methodology-values,
      .ips-methodology-final {
        padding: 65px 0;
      }

      .ips-methodology-intro-grid,
      .ips-methodology-learning-grid {
        grid-template-columns: 1fr;
        gap: 50px;
      }

      .ips-methodology-image-card img {
        height: 390px;
      }

      .ips-methodology-methods-grid {
        grid-template-columns: 1fr;
      }

      .ips-methodology-evaluation-grid {
        grid-template-columns: 1fr;
      }

      .ips-methodology-evaluation-left,
      .ips-methodology-evaluation-right {
        padding: 38px;
      }
    }

    /* =========================
       MOBILE
    ========================== */

    @media (max-width: 600px) {
      .ips-methodology-container {
        width: calc(100% - 30px);
      }

      .ips-methodology-hero {
        padding: 55px 0;
      }

      .ips-methodology-hero-badge {
        padding: 8px 13px;
        font-size: 0.72rem;
      }

      .ips-methodology-hero-title {
        margin-top: 18px !important;
        font-size: 2.4rem;
      }

      .ips-methodology-hero-text {
        margin-top: 18px !important;
        font-size: 0.96rem;
        line-height: 1.7;
      }

      .ips-methodology-intro,
      .ips-methodology-skills,
      .ips-methodology-highlights,
      .ips-methodology-learning,
      .ips-methodology-evaluation,
      .ips-methodology-values,
      .ips-methodology-final {
        padding: 55px 0;
      }

      .ips-methodology-image-wrap::before {
        width: 80px;
        height: 80px;
        left: -10px;
        bottom: -10px;
      }

      .ips-methodology-image-wrap::after {
        width: 65px;
        height: 65px;
        right: -8px;

pages.textContent:
Our Houses


The school follows a House System in which students from Class I to XII are assigned to one of four houses. Each house is guided by a House Master and led by student leaders, including the House Captain, Vice House Captain, Cultural Captain, Literary Captain, and Sports Captain.

The four houses are Green, Yellow, Blue, and Red, named after the famous rivers of India: Narmada, Ganga, Brahmaputra, and Satluj. These rivers represent strength, determination, and the ability to overcome obstacles.

The houses organize activities during House Assemblies, and selected students participate in Inter-House competitions. These activities develop teamwork, encourage healthy competition, and motivate students to perform their best in every activity.

Challenge • Perform • Excel

The Spirit of Competition

Bringing Out the Best in Students

Competition in any form brings out the best in people and pushes them to excel. In schools, if used effectively, it can enhance learning significantly.

Competition in the classroom can be healthy and should be encouraged when it motivates students to extend themselves, explore their real capabilities and maximize their true potential.

Healthy Competition

It allows students to stretch their abilities while recognizing their strengths and areas where they can continue to improve.

Why Competition Matters

Turning Challenge Into Growth

When used effectively, competition can help students understand their capabilities and encourage them to work towards their personal best.

Extend Yourself

Students are encouraged to go beyond their comfort zone and challenge their existing abilities.

Discover Potential

Healthy challenges help students recognize and maximize their true potential.

Measure Progress

Students can evaluate their own performance and identify areas for improvement.

Strive for Excellence

Competition can motivate students to put consistent effort into their learning and activities.

Classroom Competition

A Healthy Drive to Perform Better

Traditionally, schools have fostered competition among students by assigning positions at the end of the term or semester.

Each student may be assigned a position based on the average score obtained from an aggregate of tests and assignment scores. Some schools also recognize positions by individual subjects as well as overall class performance.

This gives students an opportunity to understand their performance in different areas and compare their progress with the expectations of their learning environment.

01

Overall Performance

Understanding overall academic progress.

02

Subject Strengths

Recognizing individual areas of strength.

03

Continuous Effort

Encouraging students to maintain consistent effort.

Self Evaluation

Know Your Strength. Improve Your Game.

Students are able to match their abilities against those of their classmates and understand where they stand in their learning journey.

Through this process, students can evaluate their own competencies and recognize areas where they need to put in greater effort.

01

Evaluate

Understand your current performance.

02

Identify

Recognize strengths and challenges.

03

Improve

Decide where more effort is required.

04

Excel

Work consistently towards excellence.

The IPS Approach

Competition as a Journey of Continuous Improvement

The purpose of competition is not simply to identify who is at the top. It can also encourage students to understand their abilities, set goals, put in effort and continue improving over time.

Challenge

Take on challenges that encourage you to extend your abilities.

Effort

Put consistent effort into learning and improving performance.

Growth

Use experience to recognize progress and continue moving forward.

Compete With Purpose. Grow With Confidence.

At IPS, healthy competition encourages students to recognize their abilities, develop consistent effort and strive towards their highest potential.

All students must know Class 12 boards are crucial to crack if you want to do well in your entrance exams. This marks the beginning of your journey towards your dream college.

Let’s take a detailed look at your 1-month study plan if you want to know how to prepare CBSE board exam in one month.

30-Day Study Plan

Finish the Syllabus. Revise. Practise.

Given below is a sample timetable to finish the whole syllabus and prepare for the exam in 30 days.

30-Day Subject-Wise Preparation Plan

Days Subjects & Preparation
1–5 Physics – Keep the complete list of formulae, experiments, and derivations.
6–9 Chemistry – Questions related to organic and inorganic chemistry are fact-based questions that can be solved quickly with good practice.
10–15 Maths – Firstly, clear the basic fundamentals and concepts of the subject. Some calculations can be lengthy, so you should practise a lot of these types of questions.
16–18 English – Read as much as you can. Any piece of good literature should not escape your hands: your textbooks, the newspaper, or anything else you can lay your hands on. Follow a good grammar book and know the basic rules.
19–22 Biology / Computer Science – The key to a successful Computer Science or Biology exam is understanding. Be thorough with the diagrams and important terminologies.
23–27 Revision Days – Dedicate each day to a particular subject and revise according to your preparation needs.
27–30 Sample & Previous Year Papers – Solve sample papers or previous years' papers to improve speed, accuracy and exam readiness.

Smart Preparation

Make Your One Month Count

01

One Subject at a Time

Create a schedule for one subject at a time. You could modify it as per your preferences.

02

Set a Specific Study Time

Try and set a specific time to study every day and you’ll find that it makes things so much easier.

03

Practise Regularly

Regular practice helps strengthen concepts, improve speed and build confidence before the examination.

04

Focus on Your Goal

Remember that the grades you get in the 12th board exams do matter and they determine, to a large extent, your career graph.

Your Future Starts Here

Prepare Today for Your Dream College

Class 12 boards can be an important milestone in your academic journey. A focused plan, consistent practice and effective revision can help you approach the examination with greater confidence.

Plan • Practise • Revise
30 Days

All the Best!

Stay focused, follow your plan and give your best effort throughout your preparation.

Home visits can establish positive contact and communication with families. They are not a replacement for parent-teacher conferences, but are a process through which teachers demonstrate their support for students’ families.

pages.textContent:
Welcome to IPS

Begin a Journey of Experiential Learning

Indian Public School is a group of people passionate about making learning experiential & lifelong. The trained teachers team love teaching & work hard every day to give your child the holistic learning. Our aim is to inspire a quest for learning in your child.

Indian Public School is a one such pioneer in the field of education introducing new generation education in Sambalpur.

Learning Experiential
Education Holistic
Goal Lifelong Learning
Simple & Transparent Process

Your Admission Journey at IPS

Follow these five simple steps to become a part of the Indian Public School family.

Step 01

Visit the School Campus

Visiting school campus is an important step in selecting the right school for your child. That is the reason we take your tour seriously. Our Parent Advisor & Admission Counselor plan your school tour so that you get the maximum out of it.

1
Step 02

Submit Application Form

Fill in the application form and submit it with the required documents.

2
Step 03

Observation

After submitting the application form we will schedule an ‘Observation’ for your child. This helps us to understand the child’s learning skills and his/her readiness to the respective class for which the admission is sought.

3
Step 04

Admission

After successful completion of above process you need to deposit the term fee. The Admission process is completed and you & your child become the part of IPS family.

4
Step 05

Post Admission

We acknowledge the fact that starting a new school is a BIG change for your child & you. We also conduct a Parent Orientation Program, to make it easy for you to know your new school and to meet the Principal & fellow parents.

content.title: Playground
description: Today's schools are not only tasked with preparing children for their future careers, but also teaching essential life skills, habits and attitudes that will help them successfully navigate adulthood. To do this and provide the best learning experience for students requires both indoor instruction and outdoor physical activity.

While kids explore school playgrounds they are building important life skills that will eventually help children become effective thinkers, leaders and collaborators. Unfortunately, play is under scrutiny as school administrators, teachers and parents feel pressure for children to "perform" academically and spend more time in classroom instruction. And with the prevalence of electronics and the amount of screen time children are receiving each day, recess and free play on a playground are more important than ever.

By creating an environment where children can experience unstructured play, you're not only supporting their physical health but also increasing their chances to succeed in the classroom. Kids pay more attention to academic tasks when they are given frequent, brief opportunities for free play. Recess can also have a calming effect helping with disciplinary issues and impulse control.
Unstructured physical activity on the playground helps kids become smarter, healthier and stronger.

content.title: Curriculum
description: Indian Public School is affiliated to The Central Board of Secondary Education. The Central Board of Secondary Education (CBSE) established in the year 1929, enjoys today the distinction of being one of the oldest and largest Board of Secondary Education in India. It has about 15,000 affiliated schools in India and across 24 other countries of the world. The CBSE affiliated schools follow a uniform curriculum with a flexible scheme of studies suitable to the needs of each and every student. Notwithstanding the geographical variations, the schools and students under CBSE enjoy and share common privileges as regards the curriculum, examinations and academic innovations.

The CBSE envisions a robust, vibrant and holistic school education that will engender excellence in every sphere of human endeavour. The Board is committed to provide quality education to promote intellectual, social and cultural vivacity among its learners. It works towards evolving a learning process and environment, which empowers the future citizens to become global leaders in the emerging knowledge society. The Board advocates Continuous and Comprehensive Evaluation with an emphasis on holistic development of learners. The Board commits itself to provide a stress-free learning environment that will develop competent, confident and enterprising citizens who will promote harmony and peace.

content.title: Learning-Based Activity
content.description: The old-school model of passively learning facts and reciting them out of context is no longer sufficient to prepare students to survive in today's world. content.title: Competition @ 365 Days
description: Competition in any form brings out the best in people and pushes them to excel. In schools, if used effectively, it can enhance learning significantly.

Certainly, competition in the classroom is quite healthy; it should, in fact, be encouraged. It allows students to extend themselves, to exploit their real capabilities and maximize their true potential. It is most productive when it occurs among students of similar abilities.

Traditionally, schools have fostered competition among students by assigning positions at the end of the term/semester. Each student is assigned a position based on the average score obtained from an aggregate of tests and assignment scores. In fact, some schools give positions by subject as well as overall class position so a student may have come in the third position, but might have gained first place in Math.

Usually, the diligent student is concerned about the position that he/she acquires and no good student wants to move from a high position in the class, to a lower one. This keeps competition alive and well in the classroom. Students are able to match their abilities against that of their classmates and easily determine who their rivals are. In other words, they evaluate their own competencies and recognize who their competitors are.They can then decide how much effort they need to put into their work in order to remain at the top. Over time, they might also acknowledge that there are certain students whom they cannot match and to whom they must concede defeat.

content.title: How To Prepare For 12th Board Exams In 1 Month?
description: All students must know Class 12 boards are crucial to crack if you want to do well in your entrance exams. This marks the beginning of your journey towards your dream college. Let’s take a detailed look at your 1-month study plan if you want to know how to prepare CBSE board exam in one month.
Given below is a sample timetable to finish the whole syllabus and prepare for the exam in 30 days.
1-5. 	Physics – Keep the complete list of formulae, experiments, and derivations.
6-9. 	Chemistry – Questions related to organic and inorganic chemistry are fact-based questions that can be solved quickly with good practice.
10-15. 	Mathematics – Firstly, clear the basic fundamentals and concepts of the subject. Some calculations can be lengthy so you should practice a lot of these types of questions.

16-18. 	English – Read as much as you can. Any piece of good literature should not escape your hands: Your textbooks, the newspaper, or anything else you can lay your hands on. Follow a good grammar book and know the basic rules.
19-22. 	Biology/Computer Science – The key to a successful Computer Science or Biology exam is understanding. Be Thorough with the diagrams and important terminologies.
23-26. 	Revision - Revision days as per subjects. Dedicate each day per subject.
27-30. 	Solve Previous Year Question Papers - Appear for atleast 5 full length mock tests. Solve question papers of last 5 years in the exam hall environment.
All the best.

Empowering Every Child to Reach Their Fullest Potential

Our Academic Framework

Learning with Purpose

Indian Public School is affiliated to The Central Board of Secondary Education (CBSE) .

The Central Board of Secondary Education, established in 1929, enjoys the distinction of being one of the oldest and largest Boards of Secondary Education in India. It has about 15,000 affiliated schools in India and across 24 other countries of the world.

CBSE affiliated schools follow a uniform curriculum with a flexible scheme of studies suitable to the needs of each and every student. Not with the standing geographical variations, the schools and students under CBSE enjoy and share common privileges are regards the curriculum, examinations, and academic innovations.

Education Beyond the Classroom

The CBSE envisions a robust, vibrant and holistic school education that will engender excellence in every sphere of human endeavour. The Board is committed to providing quality education to promote intellectual, social and cultural vivacity among its learners.

The board advocates continuous and comprehensive evaluation with an emphasis on holistic development of learners. The board commits itself to provide a stress-free learning environment that will develop competent, confident and enterprising citizens who will promote harmony and peace.

Career Guidance cell


The Career information and guidance department at IPS is committed towards providing an effective platform to students to enable them to make informed decisions about their future. It provides leadership in the development and implementation of a comprehensive career education program that promotes knowledge of careers and all types of employment opportunities and that emphasizes to students the advantages of completing school with marketable skills. The School's career guidance program is based on the principles of self-development, career exploration and career management. The department provides professional guidance which is informative and most importantly tailored to each and every student's talents and aptitudes.

This preparation starts from class IX culminating beyond class Xll when the students seek, apply and attain admissions in various universities in India. The sessions help create awareness regarding various career paths beyond the conventional ones after identifying suitable courses with the help of aptitude tests and interactions. Emphasis is laid on providing each and every student the advice and guidance which is appropriate and relevant to his or her individual interests and abilities. The department works towards fostering a positive partnership between the school and each student, of course supported by the parents. The child is encouraged to use the school's resources and maximize the opportunities available in the realm of higher studies (both in India and abroad).

The Career Information and Guidance Department provides assistance in the following areas:

Information about various career options in Robotics, Avionics, Banking, IT, AI and many emerging fields.

Psychometric Analysis of student  to gauge their inherent potentials . 

Supports and administers University applications-making transcripts, recommendation letters predicted grades and the School profile.

Corresponds and follows-up with universities regarding student’s applications.

Arrange talks by university representatives and other eminent experts. Internship in the corporate sector to sensitize to the atmosphere, demands, skills and expectations of a work place.

<div class="ips-methodology-page">

  <style>
    .ips-methodology-page {
      --ips-blue: #123B70;
      --ips-dark-blue: #082A52;
      --ips-yellow: #F4C430;
      --ips-bg: #f4f8fd;
      --ips-text: #172033;
      --ips-muted: #64748b;
      --ips-border: #dce6f2;

      width: 100%;
      color: var(--ips-text);
      font-family: var(--font-sans), sans-serif;
      line-height: 1.6;
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    .ips-methodology-page *,
    .ips-methodology-page *::before,
    .ips-methodology-page *::after {
      box-sizing: border-box;
    }

    .ips-methodology-page h1,
    .ips-methodology-page h2,
    .ips-methodology-page h3,
    .ips-methodology-page p {
      margin: 0;
    }

    .ips-methodology-page img {
      display: block;
      max-width: 100%;
    }

    /* =========================
       COMMON
    ========================== */

    .ips-methodology-container {
      width: min(1200px, calc(100% - 48px));
      margin: 0 auto;
    }

    .ips-methodology-label {
      display: inline-block;
      color: var(--ips-blue);
      font-size: 0.78rem;
      font-weight: 800;
      letter-spacing: 0.18em;
      line-height: 1.4;
      text-transform: uppercase;
    }

    .ips-methodology-title {
      margin-top: 10px !important;
      color: var(--ips-dark-blue);
      font-size: clamp(2rem, 4vw, 2.8rem);
      font-weight: 800;
      line-height: 1.15;
    }

    .ips-methodology-line {
      width: 72px;
      height: 5px;
      margin-top: 20px;
      border-radius: 50px;
      background: var(--ips-yellow);
    }

    .ips-methodology-description {
      margin-top: 22px !important;
      color: var(--ips-muted);
      font-size: 1rem;
      line-height: 1.85;
    }

    /* =========================
       HERO
    ========================== */

    .ips-methodology-hero {
      position: relative;
      overflow: hidden;
      background: var(--ips-dark-blue);
      padding: 82px 0;
    }

    .ips-methodology-hero::before {
      content: "";
      position: absolute;
      width: 290px;
      height: 290px;
      left: -110px;
      top: -120px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: rgb(244 196 48 / 0.10);
    }

    .ips-methodology-hero::after {
      content: "";
      position: absolute;
      width: 330px;
      height: 330px;
      right: -140px;
      bottom: -170px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: rgb(255 255 255 / 0.05);
    }

    .ips-methodology-hero-inner {
      position: relative;
      z-index: 1;
    }

    .ips-methodology-hero-badge {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 9px;
      padding: 9px 16px;
      border: 1px solid rgb(244 196 48 / 0.4);
      border-radius: 50px;
      background: rgb(244 196 48 / 0.10);
      color: var(--ips-yellow);
      font-size: 0.82rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      letter-spacing: 0.04em;
    }

    .ips-methodology-hero-title {
      margin-top: 22px !important;
      max-width: 850px;
      color: #fff;
      font-size: clamp(2.5rem, 6vw, 4.4rem);
      font-weight: 900;
      line-height: 1.05;
      letter-spacing: -0.03em;
    }

    .ips-methodology-hero-title span {
      color: var(--ips-yellow);
    }

    .ips-methodology-hero-text {
      max-width: 760px;
      margin-top: 24px !important;
      color: #dbeafe;
      font-size: 1.12rem;
      line-height: 1.8;
    }

    /* =========================
       INTRO
    ========================== */

    .ips-methodology-intro {
      background: #fff;
      padding: 82px 0;
    }

    .ips-methodology-intro-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) minmax(0, 1fr);
      align-items: center;
      gap: 70px;
    }

    .ips-methodology-image-wrap {
      position: relative;
    }

    .ips-methodology-image-wrap::before {
      content: "";
      position: absolute;
      width: 115px;
      height: 115px;
      left: -20px;
      bottom: -22px;
      border-radius: 28px;
      background: rgb(244 196 48 / 0.28);
    }

    .ips-methodology-image-wrap::after {
      content: "";
      position: absolute;
      width: 90px;
      height: 90px;
      right: -18px;
      top: -18px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: rgb(18 59 112 / 0.10);
    }

    .ips-methodology-image-card {
      position: relative;
      z-index: 1;
      overflow: hidden;
      border: 8px solid #fff;
      border-radius: 28px;
      background: #fff;
      box-shadow: 0 20px 45px rgb(15 23 42 / 0.14);
    }

    .ips-methodology-image-card img {
      width: 100%;
      height: 430px;
      object-fit: cover;
    }

    .ips-methodology-highlight {
      display: flex;
      align-items: flex-start;
      gap: 14px;
      margin-top: 28px;
      padding: 18px 20px;
      border-left: 4px solid var(--ips-yellow);
      border-radius: 0 16px 16px 0;
      background: rgb(18 59 112 / 0.05);
    }

    .ips-methodology-highlight-icon {
      flex-shrink: 0;
      color: var(--ips-blue);
      font-size: 1.2rem;
    }

    .ips-methodology-highlight p {
      color: var(--ips-dark-blue);
      font-size: 0.94rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      line-height: 1.7;
    }

    /* =========================
       4Cs
    ========================== */

    .ips-methodology-skills {
      background: var(--ips-bg);
      padding: 82px 0;
    }

    .ips-methodology-heading-center {
      max-width: 760px;
      margin: 0 auto;
      text-align: center;
    }

    .ips-methodology-heading-center .ips-methodology-line {
      margin-left: auto;
      margin-right: auto;
    }

    .ips-methodology-heading-center .ips-methodology-description {
      max-width: 700px;
      margin-left: auto !important;
      margin-right: auto !important;
    }

    .ips-methodology-skills-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);
      gap: 22px;
      margin-top: 48px;
    }

    .ips-methodology-skill-card {
      padding: 28px;
      border: 1px solid var(--ips-border);
      border-radius: 25px;
      background: #fff;
      box-shadow: 0 3px 12px rgb(15 23 42 / 0.04);
      transition: transform 0.3s ease, box-shadow 0.3s ease;
    }

    .ips-methodology-skill-card:hover {
      transform: translateY(-7px);
      box-shadow: 0 18px 35px rgb(15 23 42 / 0.10);
    }

    .ips-methodology-skill-icon {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      width: 55px;
      height: 55px;
      border-radius: 16px;
      background: var(--ips-yellow);
      color: var(--ips-dark-blue);
      font-size: 1.35rem;
    }

    .ips-methodology-skill-card h3 {
      margin-top: 20px !important;
      color: var(--ips-dark-blue);
      font-size: 1.1rem;
      font-weight: 800;
      line-height: 1.35;
    }

    .ips-methodology-skill-card p {
      margin-top: 9px !important;
      color: var(--ips-muted);
      font-size: 0.88rem;
      line-height: 1.7;
    }

    /* =========================
       METHODOLOGY HIGHLIGHTS
    ========================== */

    .ips-methodology-highlights {
      background: #fff;
      padding: 82px 0;
    }

    .ips-methodology-section-badge {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
      padding: 9px 16px;
      border-radius: 50px;
      background: rgb(244 196 48 / 0.20);
      color: var(--ips-dark-blue);
      font-size: 0.82rem;
      font-weight: 800;
    }

    .ips-methodology-methods-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
      gap: 20px;
      margin-top: 48px;
    }

    .ips-methodology-method-card {
      display: flex;
      align-items: flex-start;
      gap: 18px;
      padding: 27px;
      border: 1px solid var(--ips-border);
      border-radius: 24px;
      background: #fff;
      box-shadow: 0 3px 12px rgb(15 23 42 / 0.04);
      transition: transform 0.3s ease, box-shadow 0.3s ease;
    }

    .ips-methodology-method-card:hover {
      transform: translateY(-5px);
      box-shadow: 0 16px 32px rgb(15 23 42 / 0.09);
    }

    .ips-methodology-method-number {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      flex: 0 0 48px;
      width: 48px;
      height: 48px;
      border-radius: 14px;
      background: var(--ips-yellow);
      color: var(--ips-dark-blue);
      font-size: 0.76rem;
      font-weight: 900;
    }

    .ips-methodology-method-card h3 {
      color: var(--ips-dark-blue);
      font-size: 1.1rem;
      font-weight: 800;
      line-height: 1.4;
    }

    .ips-methodology-method-card p {
      margin-top: 8px !important;
      color: var(--ips-muted);
      font-size: 0.89rem;
      line-height: 1.72;
    }

    .ips-methodology-tags {
      display: flex;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      gap: 7px;
      margin-top: 17px;
    }

    .ips-methodology-tag {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      padding: 6px 10px;
      border: 1px solid #dbeafe;
      border-radius: 50px;
      background: #eff6ff;
      color: var(--ips-blue);
      font-size: 0.69rem;
      font-weight: 700;
    }

    /* =========================
       LEARNING MODEL
    ========================== */

    .ips-methodology-learning {
      background: var(--ips-dark-blue);
      padding: 82px 0;
    }

    .ips-methodology-learning-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 0.95fr) minmax(0, 1.05fr);
      align-items: center;
      gap: 70px;
    }

    .ips-methodology-learning .ips-methodology-label {
      color: var(--ips-yellow);
    }

    .ips-methodology-learning .ips-methodology-title {
      color: #fff;
    }

    .ips-methodology-learning .ips-methodology-description {
      color: #dbeafe;
    }

    .ips-methodology-steps {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
      gap: 16px;
    }

    .ips-methodology-step {
      padding: 24px;
      border: 1px solid rgb(255 255 255 / 0.12);
      border-radius: 22px;
      background: rgb(255 255 255 / 0.055);
      transition: transform 0.3s ease, border-color 0.3s ease;
    }

    .ips-methodology-step:hover {
      transform: translateY(-5px);
      border-color: rgb(244 196 48 / 0.5);
    }

    .ips-methodology-step-number {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      width: 42px;
      height: 42px;
      border-radius: 12px;
      background: var(--ips-yellow);
      color: var(--ips-dark-blue);
      font-size: 0.75rem;
      font-weight: 900;
    }

    .ips-methodology-step h3 {
      margin-top: 15px !important;
      color: #fff;
      font-size: 1.05rem;
      font-weight: 800;
    }

    .ips-methodology-step p {
      margin-top: 6px !important;
      color: #bfdbfe;
      font-size: 0.84rem;
      line-height: 1.65;
    }

    /* =========================
       PROGRESS EVALUATION
    ========================== */

    .ips-methodology-evaluation {
      background: var(--ips-bg);
      padding: 82px 0;
    }

    .ips-methodology-evaluation-box {
      overflow: hidden;
      border: 1px solid var(--ips-border);
      border-radius: 32px;
      background: #fff;
      box-shadow: 0 18px 40px rgb(15 23 42 / 0.09);
    }

    .ips-methodology-evaluation-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 0.4fr 0.6fr;
    }

    .ips-methodology-evaluation-left {
      padding: 48px;
      background: var(--ips-blue);
    }

    .ips-methodology-evaluation-icon {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      width: 62px;
      height: 62px;
      border-radius: 17px;
      background: var(--ips-yellow);
      color: var(--ips-dark-blue);
      font-size: 1.45rem;
    }

    .ips-methodology-evaluation-left h2 {
      margin-top: 25px !important;
      color: #fff;
      font-size: 2rem;
      font-weight: 800;
      line-height: 1.2;
    }

    .ips-methodology-evaluation-left p {
      margin-top: 18px !important;
      color: #dbeafe;
      line-height: 1.8;
    }

    .ips-methodology-evaluation-right {
      padding: 48px;
    }

    .ips-methodology-evaluation-right h3 {
      margin-top: 10px !important;
      color: var(--ips-dark-blue);
      font-size: 1.55rem;
      font-weight: 800;
      line-height: 1.3;
    }

    .ips-methodology-evaluation-right > p {
      margin-top: 17px !important;
      color: var(--ips-muted);
      line-height: 1.8;
    }

    .ips-methodology-levels {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
      gap: 14px;
      margin-top: 26px;
    }

    .ips-methodology-level {
      padding: 20px;
      border-radius: 18px;
      background: #f8fafc;
    }

    .ips-methodology-level strong {
      display: block;
      color: var(--ips-blue);
      font-size: 1.25rem;
      font-weight: 900;
    }

    .ips-methodology-level span {
      display: block;
      margin-top: 5px;
      color: var(--ips-muted);
      font-size: 0.82rem;
    }

    /* =========================
       CORE VALUES
    ========================== */

    .ips-methodology-values {
      background: #fff;
      padding: 82px 0;
    }

    .ips-methodology-values-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);
      gap: 20px;
      margin-top: 48px;
    }

    .ips-methodology-value-card {
      padding: 26px 22px;
      border: 1px solid var(--ips-border);
      border-radius: 23px;
      background: #fff;
      text-align: center;
      transition: transform 0.3s ease, box-shadow 0.3s ease;
    }

    .ips-methodology-value-card:hover {
      transform: translateY(-6px);
      box-shadow: 0 15px 30px rgb(15 23 42 / 0.08);
    }

    .ips-methodology-value-icon {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      width: 50px;
      height: 50px;
      margin: 0 auto;
      border-radius: 15px;
      background: var(--ips-yellow);
      color: var(--ips-dark-blue);
      font-size: 1.15rem;
      font-weight: 900;
    }

    .ips-methodology-value-card h3 {
      margin-top: 17px !important;
      color: var(--ips-dark-blue);
      font-size: 1.02rem;
      font-weight: 800;
    }

    .ips-methodology-value-card p {
      margin-top: 7px !important;
      color: var(--ips-muted);
      font-size: 0.83rem;
      line-height: 1.65;
    }

    /* =========================
       FINAL
    ========================== */

    .ips-methodology-final {
      padding: 82px 0;
      background: var(--ips-bg);
      text-align: center;
    }

    .ips-methodology-final-inner {
      max-width: 820px;
      margin: 0 auto;
    }

    .ips-methodology-final-icon {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      width: 64px;
      height: 64px;
      margin: 0 auto;
      border-radius: 18px;
      background: var(--ips-yellow);
      color: var(--ips-dark-blue);
      font-size: 1.5rem;
      box-shadow: 0 10px 20px rgb(15 23 42 / 0.12);
    }

    .ips-methodology-final h2 {
      margin-top: 25px !important;
      color: var(--ips-dark-blue);
      font-size: clamp(2rem, 4vw, 2.8rem);
      font-weight: 900;
      line-height: 1.2;
    }

    .ips-methodology-final p {
      margin-top: 18px !important;
      color: var(--ips-muted);
      line-height: 1.85;
    }

    .ips-methodology-final-tags {
      display: flex;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      justify-content: center;
      gap: 10px;
      margin-top: 30px;
    }

    .ips-methodology-final-tag {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      padding: 10px 19px;
      border-radius: 50px;
      font-size: 0.8rem;
      font-weight: 800;
    }

    .ips-methodology-final-tag-blue {
      background: var(--ips-blue);
      color: #fff;
    }

    .ips-methodology-final-tag-yellow {
      background: var(--ips-yellow);
      color: var(--ips-dark-blue);
    }

    /* =========================
       LARGE TABLET
    ========================== */

    @media (max-width: 1050px) {
      .ips-methodology-container {
        width: min(100% - 40px, 920px);
      }

      .ips-methodology-intro-grid,
      .ips-methodology-learning-grid {
        gap: 45px;
      }

      .ips-methodology-skills-grid,
      .ips-methodology-values-grid {
        grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
      }
    }

    /* =========================
       TABLET
    ========================== */

    @media (max-width: 850px) {
      .ips-methodology-hero {
        padding: 68px 0;
      }

      .ips-methodology-intro,
      .ips-methodology-skills,
      .ips-methodology-highlights,
      .ips-methodology-learning,
      .ips-methodology-evaluation,
      .ips-methodology-values,
      .ips-methodology-final {
        padding: 65px 0;
      }

      .ips-methodology-intro-grid,
      .ips-methodology-learning-grid {
        grid-template-columns: 1fr;
        gap: 50px;
      }

      .ips-methodology-image-card img {
        height: 390px;
      }

      .ips-methodology-methods-grid {
        grid-template-columns: 1fr;
      }

      .ips-methodology-evaluation-grid {
        grid-template-columns: 1fr;
      }

      .ips-methodology-evaluation-left,
      .ips-methodology-evaluation-right {
        padding: 38px;
      }
    }

    /* =========================
       MOBILE
    ========================== */

    @media (max-width: 600px) {
      .ips-methodology-container {
        width: calc(100% - 30px);
      }

      .ips-methodology-hero {
        padding: 55px 0;
      }

      .ips-methodology-hero-badge {
        padding: 8px 13px;
        font-size: 0.72rem;
      }

      .ips-methodology-hero-title {
        margin-top: 18px !important;
        font-size: 2.4rem;
      }

      .ips-methodology-hero-text {
        margin-top: 18px !important;
        font-size: 0.96rem;
        line-height: 1.7;
      }

      .ips-methodology-intro,
      .ips-methodology-skills,
      .ips-methodology-highlights,
      .ips-methodology-learning,
      .ips-methodology-evaluation,
      .ips-methodology-values,
      .ips-methodology-final {
        padding: 55px 0;
      }

      .ips-methodology-image-wrap::before {
        width: 80px;
        height: 80px;
        left: -10px;
        bottom: -10px;
      }

      .ips-methodology-image-wrap::after {
        width: 65px;
        height: 65px;
        right: -8px;
        top: -8px;
      }

      .ips-methodology-image-card {
        border-width: 5px;
        border-radius: 22px;
      }

      .ips-methodology-image-card img {
        height: 300px;
      }

      .ips-methodology-title {
        font-size: 2rem;
      }

      .ips-methodology-description {
        font-size: 0.92rem;
        line-height: 1.75;
      }

      .ips-methodology-skills-grid,
      .ips-methodology-values-grid {
        grid-template-columns: 1fr;
        gap: 15px;
        margin-top: 32px;
      }

      .ips-methodology-skill-card {
        padding: 23px;
        border-radius: 21px;
      }

Challenge • Perform • Excel

The Spirit of Competition

Bringing Out the Best in Students

Competition in any form brings out the best in people and pushes them to excel. In schools, if used effectively, it can enhance learning significantly.

Competition in the classroom can be healthy and should be encouraged when it motivates students to extend themselves, explore their real capabilities and maximize their true potential.

Healthy Competition

It allows students to stretch their abilities while recognizing their strengths and areas where they can continue to improve.

Why Competition Matters

Turning Challenge Into Growth

When used effectively, competition can help students understand their capabilities and encourage them to work towards their personal best.

Extend Yourself

Students are encouraged to go beyond their comfort zone and challenge their existing abilities.

Discover Potential

Healthy challenges help students recognize and maximize their true potential.

Measure Progress

Students can evaluate their own performance and identify areas for improvement.

Strive for Excellence

Competition can motivate students to put consistent effort into their learning and activities.

Classroom Competition

A Healthy Drive to Perform Better

Traditionally, schools have fostered competition among students by assigning positions at the end of the term or semester.

Each student may be assigned a position based on the average score obtained from an aggregate of tests and assignment scores. Some schools also recognize positions by individual subjects as well as overall class performance.

This gives students an opportunity to understand their performance in different areas and compare their progress with the expectations of their learning environment.

01

Overall Performance

Understanding overall academic progress.

02

Subject Strengths

Recognizing individual areas of strength.

03

Continuous Effort

Encouraging students to maintain consistent effort.

Self Evaluation

Know Your Strength. Improve Your Game.

Students are able to match their abilities against those of their classmates and understand where they stand in their learning journey.

Through this process, students can evaluate their own competencies and recognize areas where they need to put in greater effort.

01

Evaluate

Understand your current performance.

02

Identify

Recognize strengths and challenges.

03

Improve

Decide where more effort is required.

04

Excel

Work consistently towards excellence.

The IPS Approach

Competition as a Journey of Continuous Improvement

The purpose of competition is not simply to identify who is at the top. It can also encourage students to understand their abilities, set goals, put in effort and continue improving over time.

Challenge

Take on challenges that encourage you to extend your abilities.

Effort

Put consistent effort into learning and improving performance.

Growth

Use experience to recognize progress and continue moving forward.

Compete With Purpose. Grow With Confidence.

At IPS, healthy competition encourages students to recognize their abilities, develop consistent effort and strive towards their highest potential.

All students must know Class 12 boards are crucial to crack if you want to do well in your entrance exams. This marks the beginning of your journey towards your dream college.

Let’s take a detailed look at your 1-month study plan if you want to know how to prepare CBSE board exam in one month.

30-Day Study Plan

Finish the Syllabus. Revise. Practise.

Given below is a sample timetable to finish the whole syllabus and prepare for the exam in 30 days.

30-Day Subject-Wise Preparation Plan

Days Subjects & Preparation
1–5 Physics – Keep the complete list of formulae, experiments, and derivations.
6–9 Chemistry – Questions related to organic and inorganic chemistry are fact-based questions that can be solved quickly with good practice.
10–15 Maths – Firstly, clear the basic fundamentals and concepts of the subject. Some calculations can be lengthy, so you should practise a lot of these types of questions.
16–18 English – Read as much as you can. Any piece of good literature should not escape your hands: your textbooks, the newspaper, or anything else you can lay your hands on. Follow a good grammar book and know the basic rules.
19–22 Biology / Computer Science – The key to a successful Computer Science or Biology exam is understanding. Be thorough with the diagrams and important terminologies.
23–27 Revision Days – Dedicate each day to a particular subject and revise according to your preparation needs.
27–30 Sample & Previous Year Papers – Solve sample papers or previous years' papers to improve speed, accuracy and exam readiness.

Smart Preparation

Make Your One Month Count

01

One Subject at a Time

Create a schedule for one subject at a time. You could modify it as per your preferences.

02

Set a Specific Study Time

Try and set a specific time to study every day and you’ll find that it makes things so much easier.

03

Practise Regularly

Regular practice helps strengthen concepts, improve speed and build confidence before the examination.

04

Focus on Your Goal

Remember that the grades you get in the 12th board exams do matter and they determine, to a large extent, your career graph.

Your Future Starts Here

Prepare Today for Your Dream College

Class 12 boards can be an important milestone in your academic journey. A focused plan, consistent practice and effective revision can help you approach the examination with greater confidence.

Plan • Practise • Revise
30 Days

All the Best!

Stay focused, follow your plan and give your best effort throughout your preparation.

About Indian Public School

School Establishment

Discover the foundation, vision and learning environment that define Indian Public School, Sambalpur.

Established

2009

2nd April

Indian Public School was established on 2nd April, 2009 under The KS Dalmia Education Trust.

The school has credo towards character building and all-round personality development covering areas of intellectual stimulations, physical robustness, social adaptability, emotional independence, in-depth knowledge of subjects, fluency and good communication skills, confidence building and leadership qualities.

A Complete Learning Environment

The School is spread over 7 acres of land, the school is equipped with facilities comparable with the best in the country, both in academics and extra-curricular activities. It is these 'extras' that will make your child's education complete.

Indian Public School, Sambalpur

Indian Public School- Best Residential School in Sambalpur. The school has strength of 1000+ students and classes from Pre Primary level up to Class XII. There are more than 50 teachers around 25 other staff members and an enviable state-of-the-art infrastructure.

IPS is affiliated to the Central Board of Secondary Education (C.B.S.E.), New Delhi.

A Legacy of Excellence

Indian Public School, Sambalpur is an epitome of dignity, pride, values and a recognized landmark in its pursuit of excellence in education and holistic development. IPS has maintained a proud legacy of excellence offering super co-educational institution offering world-class infrastructural and education facilities and learning experience.

IPS is deeply dedicated in building "World Leaders Of Tomorrow" . Indian Public School offers a compelling combination of small classes, caring faculty, academic rigor and strong spiritual values.

Beyond Classroom Learning

Indian Public School caters to the ever expansive 'Indian Middle Class' which is looking at ensuring its child with the best in education and other activities.

pages.textContent:
WELCOME TO IPS

Begin a Journey of Experiential Learning

Indian Public School is a group of people passionate about making learning experiential & lifelong. The trained teachers team love teaching & work hard every day to give your child holistic learning. Our aim is to inspire a quest for learning in your child.

Indian Public School is a pioneer in the field of education, introducing new generation learning in Sambalpur.


SIMPLE & TRANSPARENT PROCESS

Your Admission Journey at IPS

Follow these simple steps to become a part of the Indian Public School family.

1. Visit the School Campus

Visiting the school campus is an important step in selecting the right school for your child. Our Parent Advisor & Admission Counselor plan your tour to ensure you get the maximum value from your visit.

2. Submit Application Form

Fill in the application form and submit it along with the required documents.

3. Observation

After submitting the application form, we will schedule an 'Observation' for your child. This helps us understand their learning skills and readiness for the respective class.

4. Admission

Upon successful completion of the observation step, you will need to deposit the term fee to complete the admission process and officially join the IPS family.

5. Post Admission

Starting at a new school is a big change. We conduct a Parent Orientation Program to help you get acquainted with the school, meet the Principal, and connect with fellow parents.

reviews.name: Parents of Chinmayee | Grade: II
reviews.feedback: We chose Indian Public School for our daughter Chinmayee’s I Class and it has been a wonderful decision. She comes from a different state and environment, but the school and her teachers made her feel comfortable and welcomed from the very beginning. The teachers have been extremely supportive and helped her overcome her initial discomfort.

reviews.name: Parents of Aadhrith | Grade: III
reviews.feedback: As parents of Aadhrith, we would like to express our heartfelt gratitude for the excellent all-round development provided by the school. The curriculum is age-appropriate and perfectly blends literature, mathematics and science. Our child comes home excited to share new knowledge, which reflects a strong eagerness to learn.

reviews.name: Parents of Puneet Agrawal | Grade: IV
reviews.feedback: Indian Public School is an English-medium school and one of the best schools in our city. Students learn new things every day at the school. The school has a very clean and natural environment along with a big playground. All the teachers are very polite, supportive, kind, loving, cooperative and intelligent. The teachers help students differentiate between good and bad in life.

reviews.name: Parents of Anwesha | Grade: VIII
reviews.feedback: We have enrolled our child Anwesha Brahma (Grade 8th) in IPS this year. We appreciate the motivating and open culture of the school. The staff is well qualified and courteous. Kids are encouraged to interact and not be afraid of their teachers. They respect their teachers and are making good progress in all areas. We are thankful to the Teaching Staff and the Management for our kids’ progress.

reviews.feedback: We parents of Pratyusha Chandra, Class VII, feel happy to write about Indian Public School. My daughter is happy going to school. Teachers are supportive and caring. Good manners and etiquettes are also emphasised along with academic development. There has been a great change in her, and we wholeheartedly give the credit to the school for grooming her.

reviews.name: Parents of Divjot Singh | Grade: IX
reviews.feedback: I’m very much thankful to the teachers and the entire team of the school for the holistic and good development of my child. I have witnessed good communication and speaking skills in him. He is able to cope up with many things related to studies and his future. Thanks once again for your each and every effort.

Kids are encouraged to interact and not be afraid of their teachers. They respect their teachers and are making good progress in all areas. We are thankful to the Teaching Staff and the Management for our kids’ progress.

reviews.name: Palak Sahu | Grade: III
reviews.feedback: I, Palak Sahu of Class III, sincerely appreciate my school for providing a wonderful environment for learning and growth. Our teachers are dedicated, caring and always encourage us to give our best in academics and activities. My school not only imparts knowledge but also teaches us values, discipline and confidence. I feel honoured and proud to be a student of such a great institution. My school helps me discover my talents and inspires me to dream big. We are encouraged to participate in sports, arts and cultural activities. Every day at school is full of learning, joy and new experiences. I will always be thankful to my school for shaping my future.

reviews.name: Abantika Bhoi | Grade: VIII
reviews.feedback: My school is a place where I learn, grow and make many beautiful memories. Coming to school makes me feel happy and joyful, which makes learning more interesting and exciting. Our honourable Principal and all the teachers are highly qualified, kind, friendly and always ready to help us. The classrooms are well designed and properly maintained, which helps me study peacefully. My school not only focuses on studies but also teaches good manners, discipline and respect. I feel proud to be a student of my school because it helps me become more confident and responsible day by day.

reviews.name: Shrividya Nayak | Grade: X
reviews.feedback: I am Shrividya Nayak, a student of Class X at Indian Public School, and I truly feel fortunate to be a part of this esteemed institution. Indian Public School is not just a place where I study; it is where my thoughts are shaped, my confidence is nurtured and my character continues to grow. Each day at school brings new learning—not only from textbooks but also from experiences that instil discipline, empathy, perseverance and self-belief. The teachers here are more than educators; they are dedicated mentors who inspire us to dream fearlessly, think independently, and overcome challenges with determination.

reviews.name: Avanti Pathak | Grade: X
reviews.feedback: I am Avanti Pathak, a student of Grade X at Indian Public School. My experience at this school has been truly enriching and inspiring. The teachers here are very supportive, knowledgeable, and always encourage us to give our best in academics as well as co-curricular activities. The school provides a positive learning environment where students are motivated to grow with confidence, discipline, and values. Various activities, competitions and practical learning opportunities have helped me improve my skills and overall personality. I feel proud to be a part of Indian Public School, which continuously guides and prepares us for a bright future.

reviews.name: Swastika Mahakul | XII JEE
reviews.feedback: I am grateful to my school for providing a strong academic foundation and a supportive learning environment. The dedicated teachers, well-structured curriculum, and disciplined atmosphere have helped me develop conceptual clarity, critical thinking and problem-solving skills, which are essential for my JEE preparation. The constant guidance and encouragement from my teachers have motivated me to work harder and stay focused on my goals. I will always value the lessons and experiences gained here. I am very happy to be a part of this institution. Thank you.

reviews.name: Pragati Pradhan | XII NEET
reviews.feedback: I, Pragati Pradhan of Std. XII (NEET Science), experienced a very wonderful and enthusiastic journey at IPS. They have provided all essential support regarding our hostel and academic needs. They maintain a peaceful and disciplined environment, which helps students focus on their studies.
